title: Dissociation Thread
text: Deals minor physical damage and attempts to strip equipment or harvest creatures. It can shear sheep, collect eggs, or extract milk suspension from cows. Shorn sheep must regrow their wool.

Enhancement adds harvest rounds and damage; Infusion increases equipment and produce per round. Delay removes damage to creatures. Craft milk suspension with a bucket, or right-click a dropped suspension with a bucket, to collect milk.
Block Dissociation breaks suitable blocks and benefits from Fortune. Enhancement allows harder blocks to be affected; Infusion improves Fortune. Delay does not change block Dissociation.
With Explosion, Dissociation affects suitable blocks and creatures within the area.
